name: Ancestris
description: Current v13/v14 fetch the NetBeans update centers + .nbm modules over validated HTTPS; modules are unsigned, so a compromise of dl.ancestris.org would still allow a malicious module → RCE. Corrected D→C: the earlier plaintext-HTTP finding came from a stale GitHub mirror; verified against the canonical SVN trunk (svn.ancestris.org).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Core and extension update centers are enabled at HTTP URLs.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement remain unverified.
